name_zh: 卡翁达/赞比亚/独立/铜/单一党/民主/肯尼斯/卡翁达/铜带
core_mode: M579 铜单一党/民主转型/艾滋治理/肯尼斯统治/铜经济
intellectual_tradition: 赞比亚建国/反殖民独立/铜经济治理/多党民主/西非民主/社会主义建国/铜带发展/非洲独立运动/独裁与民主过渡
description_zh: 肯尼斯·卡翁达 (1924-) 赞比亚首任总统 (1964-1991)，领导了赞比亚的独立运动和建国，倡导非暴力抵抗和平等政治，重视铜矿资源开发和经济建设。
description_en: Kenneth Kaunda (1924-) Zambia's first President (1964-1991), led Zambia's independence movement and nation-building, advocating non-violent resistance and equal politics, focusing on copper mining and economic development.
reason_zh: 卡翁达总统领导的赞比亚独立运动展示了非殖民地化国家建设模式，通过铜经济驱动发展，通过一党制实现政治稳定，通过非洲团结实现国际地位。
reason_en: President Kaunda's Zambian independence movement showcases a model for newly decolonized nations, using copper economy to drive development, implementing one-party rule for political stability, and achieving international status through African unity.
steps_zh: 独立运动：1950-1964 反殖民斗争/非洲独立联盟/非暴力抵抗/英国殖民统治/独立斗争
建国时期：1964-1970 一党执政/铜经济开发/工业化建设/社会主义建设/国际地位提升
巩固时期：1971-1990 铜带开发/教育发展/医疗保健/基础设施建设/政治稳定
民主过渡：1990-1991 民主改革/多党制建立/铜经济改革/国际地位巩固
steps_en: Independence movement: 1950-1964 anti-colonial struggle/ African Independence Alliance/ non-violent resistance/ British colonial rule/ independence struggle
Nation-building period: 1964-1970 one-party rule/ copper economy development/ industrialization/ socialist construction/ international status enhancement
Consolidation period: 1971-1990 copper belt development/ education development/ healthcare/ infrastructure/ political stability
Democratic transition: 1990-1991 democratic reform/ multi-party system/ copper economy reform/ international status consolidation
expected_zh: 掌握非洲独立运动如何通过非暴力抵抗实现国家建设，学习卡翁达总统在铜经济治理和一党制政治下的领导艺术，了解非洲国家建设模式。
expected_en: Master how African independence movements achieve nation-building through non-violent resistance, learn President Kaunda's leadership in copper economy governance and one-party politics, understand African nation-building models.
case_zh: 1964 独立；1970 铜带开发；1990 民主改革；1991 退休/铜经济/一党制/民主过渡/非洲独立/铜带/教育/医疗。
case_en: 1964 independence; 1970 copper belt development; 1990 democratic reform; 1991 retirement/copper economy/one-party system/democratic transition/African independence/copper belt/education/healthcare.
